description: This test file contains unit tests for verifying the correctness of the OpenAPI schema generation and Swagger UI URL configurations in a FastAPI (or similar) web application. It uses pytest for test definitions and asyncio for asynchronous testing, primarily focusing on ensuring relative URL resolution in different proxy scenarios.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema_can_be_generated(app)
methods.description: Tests that the OpenAPI schema can be generated and contains expected keys such as 'openapi', 'paths', and root '/' endpoint.

methods.name: test_swagger_ui_uses_relative_openapi_url_under_forwarded_prefix(async_client)
methods.description: Verifies Swagger UI uses a relative URL './openapi.json' when accessed under a forwarded prefix header to ensure correct URL resolution.

methods.name: test_swagger_ui_uses_relative_openapi_url_when_accessed_via_proxy_prefixed_path(async_client)
methods.description: Ensures Swagger UI uses the relative URL './openapi.json' even when accessed via a proxy-prefixed path without forwarded headers.

methods.name: test_swagger_ui_uses_relative_openapi_url_when_proxy_strips_prefix(async_client)
methods.description: Checks that Swagger UI provides a relative OpenAPI URL './openapi.json' when proxy settings strip the mount prefix but convey the original external path via headers.
